subject: Temporary archive bridge + data sunset approval request
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sylvia Choi <sylvia.choi@meridianhealth.com>, legal@meridianhealth.com
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Sep 2025 09:15:00 +0000
Subject: Temporary archive bridge + data sunset approval request

Sylvia / Meridian legal team —

Thanks for the call this morning. As discussed, Meridian needs a short-term archival bridge for a subset of customer logs while you finalize the certification scoping with Audit C. We want to propose a controlled path that preserves your ability to produce evidence while allowing Redwood to proceed with an upcoming retention trimming (the "sunset") on 2025-10-15.

High-level proposal: 
- Scope: logs for integrations tagged "meridian-prod" (approx. 220GB compressed)
- Temporary archive window: 2025-10-01 -> 2026-01-01 (90 days)
- Access: read-only for Meridian Legal & Audit; retrieval requests via ops ticket; full parity audit logs retained for 180 days
- Deletion: on 2026-01-02 Redwood will execute the purge unless we receive a signed waiver or a preservation order

Attachments: temp-archive-waiver.pdf (proposed waiver + ops checklist), dpa-amendment-diff.docx (minimal DPA addendum describing archive handling).

Ask: Can Meridian Legal provide a signed temporary-archive waiver (or confirm we should treat it as a legal hold) by 2025-10-07? We need the signoff to delay the sunset for your scope.

If helpful I can loop in Ops to schedule a one-hour window to stage the archive on 2025-10-01.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Sr. Manager, Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: temp-archive-waiver.pdf (PDF, 48KB)]
[Attachment: dpa-amendment-diff.docx (DOCX, 12KB)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sylvia Choi <sylvia.choi@meridianhealth.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Sep 2025 11:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Temporary archive bridge + data sunset approval request

Jonas —

Quick clarifications from our side for the waiver text so Ops has concrete runbook items: 
1) Is the archive a separate blobstore export or an immutable snapshot within our existing object store? (affects restore.)
2) Who gets the audit log tokens to demonstrate retrieval events? We normally issue short-lived tokens to requesters and retain the token issuance log for 180d.
3) Any special encryption key handling? If Meridian requires their own KMS key, that's a customer-managed flow and will change the timeline.

If Sylvia can confirm (1) snapshot vs export and (3) KMS preference, I’ll update the waiver and Ops checklist.

Kimberly
Kimberly Park
VP, Product Security
Redwood Inference

From: Sylvia Choi <sylvia.choi@meridianhealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: legal@meridianhealth.com, ops-support@meridianhealth.com
Date: Tue, 30 Sep 2025 16:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Temporary archive bridge + data sunset approval request

Jonas / Kimberly —

Thanks for the clear proposal. A few items from Meridian Legal / Ops: 

- Prefer an immutable snapshot within Redwood’s store (not a transfer) to reduce transfer risk. Is that feasible?
- Meridian requires proof that retrieval requests will be logged and that retrieval cannot be executed without a ticket from our legal mailbox.
- On encryption: Meridian will not provide a KMS key for this short-term hold. We need assurance that keys used are single-tenant per region and that key rotation will not prevent future access during the window.

Also, Legal asks for a short clause in the waiver that prohibits automatic downstream backups from reintroducing the data into longer-lived retention tiers. Can you confirm if Redwood can provide that commitment or suggest alternative controls?

We aim to sign the waiver by 2025-10-06 pending those confirmations.

—Sylvia
Sylvia Choi
Senior Procurement Lead
Meridian Health

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sylvia Choi <sylvia.choi@meridianhealth.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Oct 2025 08:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Temporary archive bridge + data sunset approval request

Sylvia —

Thanks — answers inline and next steps below.

On snapshot vs export: we can implement an immutable snapshot in-region (preferred) and mark it "meridian-temp-archive-2025". That snapshot will be logically immutable for the duration and not discoverable by standard lifecycle jobs.

Audit & retrieval flow: retrievals must go through Meridian Legal (legal@meridianhealth.com). Ops will require a documented ticket created by your mailbox and will produce a signed retrieval manifest. Token issuance will be logged and those logs retained for 180 days (we will provide the log export on request).

Encryption/KMS: current infra uses tenant-isolated keys per cloud account in eu-west-1 and periodic rotation does not prevent access to snapshots created under the current key. For short-term holds we will freeze key rotation for the relevant keyset; Ops confirms we can do that for the 90-day window. Note this is an operational exception and requires the signed waiver.

Downstream backups: Redwood will add a protective rule to prevent lifecycle jobs from copying the snapshot to any longer-lived tier while the archive flag is active. The waiver will include that commitment language.

Proposed timeline (ops milestones): 
- 2025-10-01 0200-0400 UTC: stage immutable snapshot (Ops)
- 2025-10-02: provide retrieval manifest template and audit-log export plan to Meridian Legal
- 2025-10-06: waiver signature deadline
- 2026-01-02: scheduled purge (unless waiver/hold extended)

I'll attach an edited waiver and the DPA diff marked with the KMS/hold language. If Meridian signs by 10/06 we will defer the sunset for your scope and proceed to stage on 10/01.

Jonas
[Attachment: temp-archive-waiver.pdf (updated) (PDF, 55KB)]
[Attachment: dpa-amendment-diff.docx (updated) (DOCX, 14KB)]

All —

I reviewed the ops milestones and exception scope. Approving the temporary archive bridge under the conditions outlined (freeze key rotation, immutable snapshot, retrieval manifest + audit logging). Jonas, please proceed to schedule the staging window and cc Ops (infra-ops@redwoodinference.com) on the ticket.

Kimberly — please keep the waiver text tight and include the downstream-backup prohibition Sylvia requested. Once signed by Meridian, Ops can confirm staging and we’ll update the retention job to exclude the snapshot.

Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Operations, Redwood Inference
